body: PR #2808 is OPEN at pushed b10d20aa7667 but GitHub reports DIRTY, so no new CI has registered. Read-only merge-tree against current origin/main f9890cf67d found conflicts in mcp.rs and punt_done.rs with main commit 3df0a4c73d (TASK-1955 mailbox sweep). Proposed resolution: retain shared strict resolver for MCP (which already trims and preserves stored spelling), preserve main raw-mention-token-before-shape-filter rule so known SHA-shaped recipients can be mentioned, suppress unknown SHA tokens; preserve all GC changes. New main tests currently assume unknown newagent and zero-reader advisor/cafe1234 role aliases can deliver; update fixtures to roster humans or real live agents while retaining spelling/shape assertions. No force push; merge main and append commit, rerun focused tests/test-touched/fast gates at resulting head. This is source-overlap integration rather than a blind CI retry. Please flag any contrary boundary; PR2 compatibility ruling also remains pending.
